description: Self-hosted habit tracker with OIDC sign-in, goals, and shared challenges.

configuration.name: BASE_URL
configuration.description: User-facing HTTPS URL; must match OIDC callback configuration.

configuration.name: APP_SECURITY_ISSUERS_AGGREGARE_URL
configuration.description: HTTPS issuer URL for the chosen OIDC provider.

configuration.name: APP_SECURITY_ISSUERS_AGGREGARE_CLIENTID
configuration.description: OIDC public client ID; HabitSync uses PKCE and does not require a client secret for this issuer.

configuration.name: JWT_SECRET
configuration.description: Stable signing secret used to keep sessions valid across restarts; supply from a protected variable source.

bootstrap.notes: HabitSync accepts OIDC public clients with PKCE and supports approval for new users. User enrollment and approval remain deliberate first-run actions.

manual_steps: Register a public OIDC client with the selected provider using the exact HabitSync HTTPS callback URL.
Approve the first OIDC user in HabitSync when new-user approval is enabled.
Create and revoke API tokens in the user's profile when integrations need them.

oidc.notes: Upstream documents OIDC public clients using PKCE, multiple issuers, and optional new-user approval. Provider compatibility and account lifecycle still require live verification with the pinned image.
